key_insight: BMuon reshapes Muon’s spectral descent geometry so hidden MLP channels share a global budget, making training and structured pruning align better.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more practical way to compress large Transformers after training, with a single interpretable allocation budget instead of a fragile sparsity penalty.
method: Modifies Muon into a budgeted geometry where channels across blocks compete for shared allocation.
Derives the exact oracle as normalized steepest descent under norms interpolating between spectral and structured-sparse geometries.
Uses a minorization-maximization surrogate to solve the allocation problem during training.
evidence_signal: On ImageNet-1K ViT-S/16 and a 1B-parameter LLaMA-style model trained on FineWeb, BMuon outperforms Muon under structured MLP channel pruning.
watch_item: The allocation mechanism adds optimization complexity and its gains depend on the pruning setup and budget selection.
paper_title: BMuon: Budgeting Muon's Spectral Geometry for Structured Compressibility
